You apply to a specific major; fit with that major is weighed and space is limited. An optional second-choice major adds an essay; if admitted to the second choice you are automatically wait-listed for the first. All Computer Science + X, Gies Business and Grainger Engineering majors (and several sciences) require 3.5 years of math including trigonometry or higher

supplements.label: First-choice major essay 1
supplements.prompt: Explain, in detail, an experience you’ve had in the past 3 to 4 years related to your first-choice major. This can be an experience from an extracurricular activity, in a class you’ve taken, or through something else.

supplements.label: First-choice major essay 2
supplements.prompt: Describe your personal and/or career goals after graduating from Illinois and how your selected first-choice major will help you achieve them.

supplements.label: Undeclared applicants essay 1 (replaces first-choice major essays)
supplements.prompt: What are your future career or academic goals? You may include courses you took in high school and how these impacted your goals.

supplements.label: Undeclared applicants essay 2 (replaces first-choice major essays)
supplements.prompt: What are your academic interests? Please include 2-3 majors you’re considering at Illinois and why.

supplements.label: Second-choice major essay (only if you list a second-choice major)
supplements.prompt: Please explain your interest in your second-choice major or your overall academic or career goals.
